scope: Two stock native standard fixtures, shot119-0, PRNG169032. Two stock offer-lifecycle observed runs, compared to existing unobserved digests. Plain snapshots only; no candidate, clock, RNG sequence or position/controller change.

derivedStandardMetreScale.source: v160WorldGeometry standard44x68 and v55Field spans544/600,688/740. Validated against every recorded actual native initial gap/forward gap.

findings: Several depth intentions expire after about1.05s with substantial remaining movement distance; both raw target and actual last formation-limited/smoothed target are distinguished.
Native renewal applies.55s recovery to outgoing depth runners and sometimes has no alternative eligible depth runner. Reassignment can wait until the next offer expiry, after recovery already ended.
Most native offer resets are caused by owner changes. Expired intent purges with no owner are separately reported, not treated as a possessed-carrier cancellation.
Many raw depth targets lie beyond observed formation/offside limits. Intended target nonarrival alone therefore does not establish an avoidable loss of a legal chance.
Mechanism is demonstrated in two stock fixtures; influence on shot volume and broad oscillation is not demonstrated.
limits: Two standard configurations of one seed/fixture, not population balance. No large fixture was needed or run.
Owner equality records native registered owner/current owner at reset, or assignment/endpoints for reassignment. Ownership continuity during every intervening frame was not recorded.
Actual target distance is derived from recorded lastObservedTarget/endPosition with proven native scale. The legal formation limit may move between samples.
Recovery movement totals combine support/depth and reset reasons. They cannot establish expiry-only retreat or lost chance volume.
No candidate, production edit, RNG sequence change, clock change, controller tuning, Unity/build/device work. All own contexts/server closed.
Depth destinations are carrier-relative: an initial target behind the runner or negative net progress is observed geometry, not automatically a mistake or expiry-caused oscillation.

rows.recoveryMotionLimit: Per-player recovery aggregation includes support runners and multiple reset reasons. It does not isolate expiry-only motion; no expiry-caused oscillation magnitude is inferred from these totals.
